name: Checkbox
description: Radix Checkbox with a Lucide check indicator. Supports an indeterminate state through checked="indeterminate".
intent: An independent yes-or-no choice, or one of several non-exclusive options.

props.name: className
props.hint: Merged with the component classes via cn(). Use for layout only — never to override a variant that already exists.

notes: Radix supplies role, aria-checked and the mixed state. Do not add them by hand.
Group related checkboxes in a fieldset with a legend.

usage: Opting in or out of one thing
Selecting several items from a list
A parent checkbox summarising children, via the indeterminate state
doNotUse: Exactly one choice from several — use ui:radio-group
A setting that applies immediately — use ui:switch, which reads as a state rather than a selection
Selecting from many options — use ui:select or ui:command
Using a checkbox where exactly one option must be chosen

agentRules: Always pair with ui:label using htmlFor.
Use indeterminate for parent rows rather than a third visual style.
A checkbox that applies instantly should probably be a ui:switch.
